def.zh: 滑行时间中，输出画面含完整主体、≥300 px，且主体上无≥1 px 的产品伪影（杆/绳）
def.en: share of skiing time with the full subject in the output frame, ≥300 px, and no product artefact ≥1 px over the subject (stick/tether)

def.zh: 1080p 等效输出中主体（脚→头）中位像素高，受原生分辨率限制
def.en: median feet→head height in a 1080p-equivalent output, native-resolution limited

jitterRms.zh: 画面抖动（>1 Hz 视线角速度 RMS）

def.zh: 产品真实稳像/重构图之后，主体视线相对相机的角速度经 1 Hz 高通后的 RMS（ASSUMED 可观看上限）
def.en: RMS of the >1 Hz line-of-sight angular rate relative to the camera after the stabilisation/reframing the product really has (ASSUMED watchability limit; no video-jitter literature found — nearest: VR cybersickness onset ≈24 °/s; viewer test needed)

def.zh: 一趟内可按指令获得的相对滑行方向的观察方位 p5–p95 跨度（0.2 Hz 低通）
def.en: p5–p95 span of viewing azimuth relative to heading deliverable on command within a run (0.2 Hz low-pass)

def.zh: 滑行时身上全部附加质量，含停靠的飞行器、所依赖的电池/充电宝、卷轴与支架
def.en: everything worn while skiing incl. docked aircraft, batteries/power banks relied on, reels and frames

def.zh: 直立滑行各工况（含挂枝）装置对身体力的 50 ms 滑动平均峰值，扣除静重
def.en: peak 50 ms moving mean of device force on the body minus static weight, all upright scenarios incl. snags (ASSUMED target: no wearer force-tolerance literature found, calibration 2026-10-18)

def.zh: 滑行中每次操作计 1 s；停稳时的操作不计
def.en: 1 s per action while moving; actions while stopped do not count

setupTime.zh: 每趟停留时间（展开+收纳）

def.zh: 0–9 m/s 风中 90 百分位，含停靠失败重试
def.en: 90th percentile over 0–9 m/s wind, incl. dock retries

def.zh: 展开/起飞、收纳/降落、换电、找回

keMax.en: Max KE that can strike others

def.zh: 离骑手 >1.5 m 时按雪面系，≤1.5 m 按骑手系；14.9 J 参照 FAA Part 107 第 2 类，80 J 为硬否决线
def.en: ground frame beyond 1.5 m of the rider, rider frame within; 14.9 J per FAA Part 107 Cat 2, 80 J hard kill line

def.zh: −10 °C、保留储备、按标准工况平均功率，一次充电（含全部随身电池）的累计拍摄分钟
